ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping
District symbols and RS-3 residential single-unit (detached house) district symbols as

shown on Map No. 12-G

in the area bounded by:

The public alley next north of and parallel to West Garfield Boulevard; South May

Street; West Garfield Boulevard; and South Racine Avenue.

To those of a C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 1134-1158 W. Garfield Boulevard
